name: Wool
overview: Scripture addresses wool primarily in the context of clothing, emphasizing its use and the care required when it is affected by impurity, as seen in Leviticus 13:47-52 where woollen garments afflicted with leprosy must be examined by the priest and, if unclean, destroyed by fire. Additionally, wool held a special status, with the first fleece belonging to the priests and specific restrictions placed on its use, such as the prohibition of mixing wool with other fabrics and its exclusion from the priest's temple dress. These instructions highlight both the practical and sacred considerations surrounding wool in the Old Testament.
